title: The Enterprise AI Accountability Framework
subtitle: A telecom-derived lexicon for the AI transaction economy
excerpt: AI is becoming a transaction economy. This paper coins four accountability primitives — the Token Detail Record, the Proxy of Record, the Model Routing Engine, and the Model Decision Record — each minted from a proven telecom ancestor, and argues they arrive in a forced order: record, centralize, govern, justify.

title: AI Has a Trillion-Dollar Accounting Problem. Telecom Has Solved It for Forty Years.
subtitle: Contributed article
excerpt: Every prompt, retrieval, and agent step is a priced economic event — a transaction economy most enterprises cannot independently audit. Telecom solved this decades ago with the Call Detail Record and still runs that discipline every day. AI can inherit it.
